evidence.title: 芥舟
evidence.excerpt_zh: 水中亭子小而幽喻物名之曰芥舟舟已非舟芥豈芥兩㤀離即幻隨流
evidence.summary: A very small pavilion in the water named for the boat of the Zhuangzi. The poems sit in runs on garden halls and do not name 玉玲珑馆; only the S01 label places it. The phrase 芥舟 in the 海岳开襟 poem (S05 j83:11b) is a figure of speech, not this pavilion.

evidence.title: 芥舟
evidence.locator: v4 p.7, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 9-179
evidence.excerpt_zh: 杯水无殊覆坳堂，堂如舟亦芥堪方。蒙庄原谓胶舟者，安识须弥个里藏。
evidence.summary: Poem 芥舟 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

evidence.title: 芥舟
evidence.locator: v4 p.12, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 10-639
evidence.excerpt_zh: 冻合池冰近砌坳，置舟杯芥总须胶。何如悟取华严旨，极大须弥个里包。
evidence.summary: Poem 芥舟 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

evidence.title: 芥舟
evidence.locator: v4 p.13, under 玉玲珑馆; source ref 10-770
evidence.excerpt_zh: 杯水坳堂芥作舟，问谁能以此乘浮。今来冰凝芥亦胶，可复于杯相傲不。
evidence.summary: Poem 芥舟 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1771, filed by the editors under 玉玲珑馆.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 玉玲珑馆
evidence.summary: Built 1747, added to about 1764, on an island south of 狮子林. Gate five bays; main hall of seven (plaque 正谊明道), rear of nine (林光澹碧). West court has 撷景室, 蹈和堂 and the square 朝晖亭 on the water; the east has five-bay 鹤安斋, the double-eaved 狎鸥亭, 随安室, a greenhouse, a fountain, 澹然书屋 and 芥舟 at the shore.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
